summary.name: cctop
summary.one_liner: A keyboard-first macOS menubar app that shows live status of AI coding sessions (Claude Code, Codex CLI/Desktop, opencode, pi) and jumps you to the matching terminal pane or editor window.
use_cases: see which AI coding session is waiting for input
jump back to the right terminal tab or editor window
track multiple Claude Code or Codex sessions at once
clean up leftover git worktrees from ended agent sessions
summary.what_it_does: cctop sits in the macOS menubar and merges session events from Claude Code, Codex CLI/Desktop, opencode, and pi into one view. Each tool reports events locally through plugins or hooks, and cctop shows green when work is progressing and orange or red when a session needs attention. A global hotkey overlays numbered badges on session cards so pressing a number jumps to that session. Jump targeting varies by app: it can focus the exact window, tab, or pane for some terminals (Kitty with remote control, Ghostty 1.3.0+, Apple Terminal), open the project in the editor, or only activate the app. It also offers a Cleanup feature for ended worktrees still on disk, a session history tab, and color themes.
notable: Global hotkey with numbered badges to jump to any session instantly
Exact-pane jump for Kitty, Ghostty 1.3.0+, and Apple Terminal; falls back to app activation elsewhere
Local-only data: session state stored as JSON in ~/.cctop/sessions/, no analytics or telemetry
Open source (listed as open-source on awesome-mac, source at github.com/st0012/cctop)
caveats: Codex hooks must be trusted once from a Codex CLI session; Codex Desktop does not show the review prompt
Plugins only work if the app is installed in /Applications or ~/Applications
Some terminals only fall back to app activation, and Kitty needs remote control enabled for exact-window targeting
